content: Standard multi-tenant RLS pattern: enable RLS on every tenant-scoped table, add client_id/tenant_id uuid not null column, then CREATE POLICY using (client_id = (select client_id from <lookup>)) WITH CHECK (same). Performance best practice (official Supabase troubleshooting docs): wrap auth.uid()/auth.jwt() and any security-definer lookup function in a SELECT so Postgres caches it as an initPlan instead of re-evaluating per row; always index the tenant_id/client_id column used in policies (100x+ speedup reported on large tables). Source: supabase.com/docs/guides/troubleshooting/rls-performance-and-best-practices.
